title: A2UI VegaChart Catalog
description: Catalog for rendering Vega and Vega-Lite charts in A2UI surfaces. Declares the VegaChart component for displaying interactive data visualizations from Vega-Lite JSON specifications.

VegaChart.description: Displays a Vega or Vega-Lite chart.

spec.description: The Vega-Lite spec to render as a JSON object.

height.description: Optional height of the chart in pixels. Defaults to 290.
